L90@P2: British Antarctic Survey (BAS), part of the UK Natural Environment
L91@P2: Research Council, is a world leader in research into global issues in
L92@P2: an Antarctic context. BAS is the UK's national Antarctic operator. It is
L93@P2: based in Cambridge, England and carries out the majority of its
L94@P2: research programme in Antarctica and the Southern Ocean. It
L95@P2: employs over 400 staff and has an annual budget of ~£40 million,
L96@P2: runs nine research programmes and operates five research stations,
L97@P2: two Royal Research Ships and five aircraft in and around Antarctica.
